items.headline: It's Week 10 and everything remains up for grabs in college football

items.headline: Duncan Brune's 91-yard TD rallies Ohio over Akron 28-20
items.description: — Duncan Brune had a 91-yard touchdown run with 3:57 remaining, and Ohio answered Akron’s fourth-quarter rally to beat the Zips 28-20 on Tuesday night.

items.headline: James-Hamilton's kickoff return, defensive stand gives Ohio 24-20 win over Eastern Michigan
items.description: — Darren James-Hamilton returned a kickoff 100 yards with 3:40 left to play and the defense made four stops at the goal line as Ohio pulled out a 24-20 win over Eastern Michigan on Saturday night to run its home winning streak to a nation-best 17...
